fact: Faerzress is a strange magical radiation that warps tunnels and makes teleportation nearly impossible.
source_quote: a region thick with Faerzress, the strange magical radiation that warps the tunnels and makes teleportation all but impossible.
subject: Faerzress

fact: The party believes the Faerzress 'blink' caused the recent demonic incursions.
source_quote: The party's working hypothesis is that the blink somehow caused the demons to show up.
subject: Faerzress blink hypothesis

fact: Sarith explains that the quartz crystals burst into a blinding flash when hurled against a hard surface.
source_quote: Sarith explained that these crystals, when hurled against a hard surface, burst into a blinding flash in a 10-foot radius.
subject: Sarith

fact: The quartz crystals shed a dim light in a 10-foot radius and force a DC 10 Constitution save on creatures caught in their thrown flash or be blinded for a minute.
source_quote: scattered through the area were fist-sized chunks of quartz that shed a dim light in a 10-foot radius... Any creature caught in the flash must make a DC 10 Constitution save or be blinded for a minute
subject: Quartz crystals

fact: The party harvests twelve of the glowing quartz crystals.
source_quote: The party set about harvesting what they could, pocketing twelve of the glowing stones
subject: crystal harvesting

fact: Daz rolls a 19 on Arcana to recall that magical darkness blocks all light, including magical light.
source_quote: Daz rolled a 19 on Arcana and recalled Zalthir's earlier explanation: magical darkness blocks all light, even magical light.
subject: Daz Arcana check

fact: Fuurm is a wretched human and former slave of the Drow.
source_quote: The party discovers two wretched humans, Fuurm and Baedora, who are former slaves of the Drow.
subject: Fuurm

fact: Baedora is a wretched human and former slave of the Drow.
source_quote: The party discovers two wretched humans, Fuurm and Baedora, who are former slaves of the Drow.
subject: Baedora

fact: Daz rolls a 22 on Investigation and spots the telltale Drow prisoner markings on the survivors.
source_quote: Daz rolls a 22 on Investigation and spots the telltale Drow prisoner markings.
subject: Daz Investigation check

fact: Fuurm holds up a crystal and declares they are not going back when he sees Daz is a drow.
source_quote: Seeing that Daz is a drow, Fuurm holds up a crystal and declares they are not going back.
subject: Fuurm warning

fact: Daz rolls a 24 on Insight and determines Fuurm and Baedora are driven by desperation rather than malice.
source_quote: Daz rolls a 24 on Insight and reads it as pure desperation: two hungry people in dilapidated clothes who see a big armed group as their way out, not agents sent to follow the party.
subject: Daz Insight check

fact: Fuurm entered the Underdark to save his sister but was captured, escaping recently during a demonic attack on his captors.
source_quote: Fuurm explains he entered the Underdark to save his sister but was captured, only recently escaping during a demonic attack on his captors.
subject: Fuurm

fact: Fuurm's sister was stolen from the Overbright by the Drow.
source_quote: The GM adds that the sister was stolen from the Overbright by the Drow
subject: Fuurm's sister

fact: Fuurm is described as 'just a farmer' with no special skills, though his survival seems unusual.
source_quote: Fuurm is "just a farmer" with no special skills, whose survival "strikes you as very odd."
subject: Fuurm

fact: The party agrees to let Fuurm and Baedora travel along after Daz offers them food and water.
source_quote: Daz invites the survivors to share food and water and tell their story; the party agrees to let them travel along
subject: party decision

fact: Zalthir urges the party to keep an eye on the new survivors.
source_quote: with Zalthir urging everyone to keep an eye on them.
subject: Zalthir

fact: The last stray character the party picked up turned out to be a psychotic believer.
source_quote: the GM notes that the last stray the party picked up turned out to be a psychotic believer
subject: previous stray
